verdicts.decision_note: The client identifies the supplied manuscript as containing her updated dedication, establishing the dedication content source for the paperback document.
Target-specific implementation claim: the tightly bounded context identifies the updated dedication as one of the three completed document changes.
First concrete failure: the client reports that the Dedication page is absent from the supplied document.
The client changes the dedication-page content by requesting deletion of its last two lines; the new attribute does not conflict with or remove any prior key.
The client cumulatively changes the dedication-page content by adding deletion of the final paragraph; updating the existing deletion list requires no separate key removal.
